name: Insert Fee Type
script:
fin_yr = frappe.form_dict.fin_yr
fee_type = frappe.form_dict.fee_type
desc = frappe.form_dict.desc

doc = frappe.get_doc({
    'doctype': "Fee Type",
    'type': fee_type,
    'description': desc,
    'financial_year': fin_yr
})
doc.insert()

name: Insert Fee Category

name: Get Fee Structure Data
script:
data = frappe.db.get_all('Fee Structure')
result = []
for fs in data:
    fs = frappe.get_doc('Fee Structure',fs.name,ignore_permissions=True)
    for co in fs.components:
        result.append({
            'name': fs.name,
            'program': fs.program,
            'category': co.fees_category,
            'type': co.fee_type,
            'amount': co.amount,
            'school': fs.school or fs.institution,
            'fin_yr': fs.academic_year
        })
frappe.response['message'] = result
